title: Euclidean length bound under perturbation
statement: Let $I$ be a finite set, let $P\in\mathbb R$, and let $d_i,g_i\in\mathbb R$ for each $i\in I$. Then $\sqrt{P^2+\sum_{i\in I}d_i^2}\le\sqrt{P^2+\sum_{i\in I}g_i^2}+\sqrt{\sum_{i\in I}(d_i-g_i)^2}$.
replaced: For a finite set $I$, a real scalar $P$, and vectors $d,g\in\mathbb R^I$, $\sqrt{P^2+\sum_i d_i^2}\le\sqrt{P^2+\sum_i g_i^2}+\sqrt{\sum_i(d_i-g_i)^2}$.
